description: cloister/connections/v1 vectors (ADR-0046 Slice 1 S2, ley-line-open-e9d940). Every `input` is the document text, byte for byte after JSON-decoding this file's string. `cases` pin the canonical bytes and connectionsDigest (BLAKE3-256 over the canonical bytes); a case with `canonicalFile` canonicalizes to that pinned file. Every `rejects` input is refused, and `refusal` pins the connection (its name, or #<index> when the name is not a valid label; null at document level), the field and the reason code; `schemaRefuses` says whether connections.schema.json refuses it too.

cases.name: adr-example
cases.description: The ADR-0046 S2 example: one connection from cloister's channel socket to a kind NodePort on 127.0.0.1. The input is the canonical document.

cases.name: adr-example-keys-reversed-compact
cases.description: The same document with every object's keys in reverse order and no whitespace: it canonicalizes to the pinned file.

cases.name: cloister-three-connections
cases.description: Cloister's shape: three ports of bundle `orders`, each at <channelDir>/<bundle>.<port>.sock in one realpath'd macOS channel directory, each to 127.0.0.1:<hostPort>. The input is the canonical document.

cases.name: cloister-three-connections-unsorted
cases.description: The same three connections in emit order (db, api, cache-1), keys in insertion order, tab and CRLF whitespace: sorted by name, they reach the pinned file.

cases.name: one-element-list-stays-a-list
cases.description: Unlike confinement/v1 rule 5, a one-element connections list is never written as its element.

cases.name: target-127-0-0-2
cases.description: The type represents all of 127.0.0.0/8; slice 1's runtime delivers only 127.0.0.1 and refuses this at start, not at parse.

cases.name: target-127-255-255-254
cases.description: The top of 127.0.0.0/8 short of the broadcast address, as the loopback probe tests it.

cases.name: target-ipv6-loopback
cases.description: ::1, the one IPv6 spelling the type admits. The receipt writes it [::1]:30080.

cases.name: endpoint-at-103-bytes
cases.description: An endpoint of exactly 103 bytes, the most a sun_path holds on macOS less its NUL.

cases.name: port-bounds-and-name-bounds
cases.description: Ports 1 and 65535, a one-character name and a 63-character name.

cases.name: dot-prefixed-components-are-not-dot-components
cases.description: `.hidden` and `..x` are names, not the `.` or `..` components the path rule refuses.
